caption: Delay line N = 3 gt (track delay): a sticky piston pushes a redstone block one cell (it arrives 3 gt after the input rises and leaves 1 gt after it falls); the output touches the block's new cell, and a repeater behind that cell feeds the output again 2 gt later through a stone and two dusts: the OR of the 3/1 and 5/3 copies is a 3/3 delay

Delay line N = 1 gt (track delay): a dust between the input (west) and the output cell (east), bent at rest by a redstone block south of it (which powers it but makes it point north-south). The input powers a sticky piston that pushes that block east, next to the output cell: the block leaves the dust 1 gt after the rise (the dust, powered by the input, straightens and points into the output) and arrives next to the output 3 gt after it; after the fall the block keeps the output on until the piston pulls it back, 1 gt after the fall.
Comparator line N = 2 gt (track delay, family delay-cmp: N = 2 + 2n gt, n = 0): 1 compare-mode comparator(s) in a row on stones, 2 gt each; keeps pulses down to 2-3 gt

Delay line N = 11 gt (track delay, family delay-piston-or11: N = 11 + 8n gt, n = 0): a sticky piston pushes a redstone block one cell (it arrives 3 gt after the input rises, leaves 1 gt after it falls); a dust next to its new cell is also fed 2 gt later by a repeater behind that cell (through a stone and two dusts): the OR of the 3/1 and 5/3 copies is a 3/3 delay; repeaters after the dust add the rest (delays [4])
